column1: HYPERLINK FOR ENDORSED FILE FOR TDG
Follow the steps below when opening the spreadsheet and supporting documents for this review activity.
1. Review Data Elements in the Data Dictionary (Draft Copy Only)
All actions in this stage must be completed in the draft version of the Data Dictionary spreadsheet.
1.1 Determine the Status of Each Data Element
Open the sheet “PeRef Logical Information Model”.
For each data element, select an appropriate status:
Include
Exclude
Review
1.2 Identify the Associated Workflow Task
Open the sheet “Workflow task Consensus”.
For each data element, identify the workflow task it aligns with.
Use the Minimum Viable Workflow as the reference workflow when making this decision.
1.3 Assign Additional Columns to CDG Members
The following columns from the DRAFT CDG Consensus – PeRef Logical Information Model (Data Dictionary) must be assigned to specific CDG members for completion:
Element ID
Source
Examples
Code System / Annotation
Occurrence
2. Review the Draft High-Level Process Workflows
2.1 Examine the Detailed and Minimum Viable Workflows
Review both workflow versions provided.
You may add comments directly using “sticky notes” on the draft workflow diagrams.
Alternatively, send your comments or suggestions to the CDG Lead.
3. Review the Use Case Description
3.1 Refer to the Operational Guide
Open Page 6 of the document titled:
“Philippine Health Referral FHIR IG (PeRef): WHO SMART Guideline L2 Operational Guide”.
Review the Use Case Description, including the accompanying table.
